'''Isabella Novik''' ({{Langx|he|איזבלה נוביק}}; born 1971)<ref>Birth year from [http://www.isni.org/isni/0000000069275177 ISNI authority control file], retrieved 2018-11-30.</ref> is a mathematician who works at the [[University of Washington]] as the [[Robert Phelps|Robert R. and Elaine F. Phelps]] professor in mathematics. Her research concerns [[algebraic combinatorics]] and [[polyhedral combinatorics]].<ref>[https://www.math.washington.edu/~novik/ Faculty profile], [[University of Washington]], retrieved 2016-11-06.</ref>

Novik earned her Ph.D. from the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in 1999, under the supervision of [[Gil Kalai]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=83602}}</ref> Her [[Thesis|doctoral dissertation]], ''Face Numbers of Polytopes and Manifolds'', won the Haim Nessyahu Prize in Mathematics, awarded by the [[Israel Mathematical Union]] for the best annual doctoral dissertations in mathematics.<ref>{{citation|url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Honours/Haim_Nessyahu_Prize/|title= The Haim Nessyahu Prize in Mathematics|work=MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive|accessdate=2020-07-20}}</ref>

She was an Alfred P. Sloan research fellow for 2006–2008,<ref>[https://www.math.washington.edu/Research/fac-awards.php Recent Faculty Awards] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161104084938/https://www.math.washington.edu/Research/fac-awards.php |date=2016-11-04 }}, University of Washington Mathematics, retrieved 2016-11-06.</ref>
and was elected as a member of the 2017 class of [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]] "for contributions to algebraic and geometric combinatorics".<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/new-fellows 2017 Class of the Fellows of the AMS], [[American Mathematical Society]], retrieved 2016-11-06.</ref>
